title: FastAPI Inventory
description: Full-stack inventory manager with product CRUD, stock restocking, and auto-seeded demo data.

techDetails.scope: Built mainly to work with Python, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. This was my first project using these core backend tools, built while learning from a YouTube playlist.
highlights: FastAPI REST API with Pydantic v2 validation and auto-generated Swagger UI docs
PostgreSQL and SQLAlchemy ORM for data modeling, sessions, and startup seeding
Responsive React dashboard for real-time inventory and stock management

title: SpringMart
description: Full-stack e-commerce app with multi-field search, image byte uploads, and paginated catalogs.

techDetails.scope: Built to apply what I learned about Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and Docker from a YouTube playlist.
techDetails.architecture: Java • Spring Boot • Spring Data JPA • Docker • React
highlights: Spring Boot REST API with JPQL multi-field search, pagination, and H2 storage
Spring Data JPA entity mappings and endpoints for raw-byte image uploads
Containerized backend with Docker and connected a React frontend client

title: Student Management System
description: Terminal Java app for student record management, grade analytics, and SQL injection defense.

techDetails.scope: My very first coding project. Built to learn Java and MySQL, using AI tools for the first time to guide me through the architecture from start to finish.
highlights: Console Java application with layered architecture separating logic from database operations
MySQL queries via JDBC using parameterized PreparedStatements to prevent SQL injection
SQL queries to generate student performance and grade distribution reports

title: wrkout
description: Workout tracker for PPL splits, built to stay consistent and log progressive overload.

techDetails.scope: Built during a low phase when I was dealing with Class 1 obesity, weighing 94 kg (207 lbs), and had just joined the gym. I designed it around my favorite PPL split to stay consistent, log workouts, and check off exercises. I used it to lose 30 kg (66 lbs) in 1 year.
highlights: Fast set logging with inline steppers and tactile feedback
Volume tracking and progressive overload calculation for PPL splits
Supabase Auth and PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS)

title: Shreyan's Arc
description: Interactive DSA roadmap tracking 58 curated interview problems across 17 coding patterns.

techDetails.scope: When I started DSA prep, I felt overwhelmed by the sheer number of LeetCode questions and roadmaps. After researching, I found NeetCode's Blind 75 and Sean Prashad's list. That inspired me to build a custom roadmap curating 58 high-yield questions across 17 patterns so I could practice without friction.
highlights: Interactive pan-and-zoom node canvas to customize roadmap layout
Firebase Auth to sync problem-solving progress across devices
58 handpicked interview problems covering 17 essential DSA patterns

title: J-Void
description: Minimal Java practice environment built for distraction-free problem solving.

techDetails.scope: I prefer clean, minimal software. I built J-Void because LeetCode's editor felt cluttered with features I didn't need, giving me a distraction-free in-browser space just for writing Java solutions.
highlights: Zero-setup Monaco code editor with automatic Allman brace formatting
Custom line bookmarking in the editor gutter for quick review
Direct LeetCode problem links aligned with Shreyan's Arc roadmap

title: WealthWise
description: Client financial planning platform featuring interactive investment and growth calculators.

techDetails.scope: Built for my father to help him reach more clients. It lets prospective clients explore services and run investment calculations before meeting him, saving time for both sides and making consultations smoother.
highlights: Interactive calculators for Investment, Retirement, Education, and Marriage goals
Direct WhatsApp lead routing and customizable advisor branding
